hero.title: Tobi
hero.intro: Most people call me Tobi. I bring ICT, communications and design together to build websites and apps, tell their stories in photos and video, and automate the repeat work behind them.

items.title: IGERI AI
items.problem: Nigerian children need AI learning help that suits their age, follows their curriculum and reflects their culture.
items.solution: A chat companion that adjusts to each child’s age group, follows the Nigerian NERDC curriculum and supports Nigerian languages, with a dashboard for parents. Built with React, TypeScript and Firebase.

items.title: DL4All Nigeria Elections
items.problem: State and local government presidents need to vote in one national election and follow the results.
items.solution: Approved voters sign in, vote once and get a receipt code. Ballots are secret and results update live, while an admin manages approvals and positions. Built with Next.js and Supabase.

items.title: SignEasy
items.problem: Many hearing Nigerians do not know sign language, which makes everyday communication with Deaf people hard.
items.solution: An offline Nigerian Sign Language reference with everyday phrases in five categories, an A to Z fingerspelling guide and instant search. Built with Flutter.

items.title: FarmLog
items.problem: Many smallholder farmers keep records on paper or from memory, so it is hard to tell whether a season made a profit.
items.solution: An offline farm diary for logging crops, growth stages, harvest dates and input costs. Built with Flutter.

items.title: Computer Shop Management System
items.problem: A computer shop has to keep track of customers, stock, sales and repair jobs.
items.solution: A database application for managing all four, with separate access for admins, sales staff and technicians. Written in C#.

about.heading: Call me Tobi
about.bio:
My name is Olukayode Israel Oluwatobiloba, but most people call me Tobi.
My experience brings together ICT, communications, design, photography and videography. They serve one goal: helping people understand an idea and use it with ease.
about.strandsHeading: Three ways I bring an idea to people

strands.title: Design it
strands.body: I shape websites and apps around the people who will use them.

strands.title: Tell its story
strands.body: I use photos, video and clear communication to show people why it matters.

strands.title: Keep it running
strands.body: I draw on ICT and automation to handle the work behind the scenes.
